changes.name: MeteorPickaxeSystem
changes.source:
local Players=game:GetService("Players")
local Debris=game:GetService("Debris")
local RS=game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local event=RS:WaitForChild("MineMeteor")
local last={}

local function givePickaxe(player)
 local backpack=player:WaitForChild("Backpack")
 if backpack:FindFirstChild("MeteorPickaxe") or (player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("MeteorPickaxe")) then return end
 local tool=Instance.new("Tool")
 tool.Name="MeteorPickaxe";tool.ToolTip="Mine the meteor!";tool.CanBeDropped=false
 local handle=Instance.new("Part")
 handle.Name="Handle";handle.Size=Vector3.new(.45,3.6,.45);handle.Color=Color3.fromRGB(105,75,50)
 handle.Material=Enum.Material.Wood;handle.CanCollide=false;handle.Massless=true;handle.Parent=tool
 local head=Instance.new("Part")
 head.Name="PickHead";head.Size=Vector3.new(3.1,.55,.65);head.Color=Color3.fromRGB(150,160,175)
 head.Material=Enum.Material.Metal;head.CanCollide=false;head.Massless=true;head.Parent=tool
 local weld=Instance.new("WeldConstraint");weld.Part0=handle;weld.Part1=head;weld.Parent=head
 head.CFrame=handle.CFrame*CFrame.new(0,1.45,0)
 tool.Parent=backpack
end
Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(p) p.CharacterAdded:Connect(function() task.wait(.5);givePickaxe(p) end) end)
for _,p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do if p.Character then task.spawn(givePickaxe,p) end end

-- Server-side cooldown protection.
event.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player)
 local now=os.clock()
 if last[player] and now-last[player]<.28 then return end
 last[player]=now
end)

changes.name: MeteorMiningEffects
changes.source:
local Players=game:GetService("Players")
local TweenService=game:GetService("TweenService")
local Debris=game:GetService("Debris")
local player=Players.LocalPlayer
local folder=workspace:WaitForChild("MeteorGame")
local gui=player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui"):WaitForChild("MeteorUI")
local lastGems=player:WaitForChild("leaderstats"):WaitForChild("Gems").Value

local function popup(amount)
 local t=Instance.new("TextLabel")
 t.AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(.5,.5);t.Position=UDim2.new(.5,0,.55,0);t.Size=UDim2.new(0,180,0,50)
 t.BackgroundTransparency=1;t.Text="+"..amount.." 💎";t.TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(110,220,255)
 t.TextStrokeTransparency=.25;t.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBlack;t.TextSize=28;t.Parent=gui
 TweenService:Create(t,TweenInfo.new(.45),{Position=UDim2.new(.5,0,.48,0),TextTransparency=1,TextStrokeTransparency=1}):Play()
 Debris:AddItem(t,.5)
end
local gems=player.leaderstats.Gems
gems:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Value"):Connect(function()
 local d=gems.Value-lastGems
 if d>0 and d<25 then popup(d) end
 lastGems=gems.Value
end)

local function impact(m)
 if not m or not m.Parent then return end
 local light=m:FindFirstChildOfClass("PointLight")
 if light then
  local b=light.Brightness;light.Brightness=8
  TweenService:Create(light,TweenInfo.new(.12),{Brightness=b}):Play()
 end
 local old=m.Color;m.Color=Color3.fromRGB(220,170,120)
 task.delay(.07,function() if m.Parent then m.Color=old end end)
 for i=1,3 do
  local c=Instance.new("Part");c.Name="RockChip";c.Shape=Enum.PartType.Ball;c.Size=Vector3.new(.35,.35,.35)
  c.Material=Enum.Material.Rock;c.Color=old;c.CanCollide=false;c.Position=m.Position+Vector3.new(math.random(-5,5),math.random(-3,5),math.random(-5,5));c.Parent=folder
  c.AssemblyLinearVelocity=Vector3.new(math.random(-12,12),math.random(8,18),math.random(-12,12));Debris:AddItem(c,.45)
 end
end

local mouse=player:GetMouse()
mouse.Button1Down:Connect(function()
 local tool=player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("MeteorPickaxe")
 local meteor=folder:FindFirstChild("Meteor")
 if tool and meteor then impact(meteor) end
end)
